scope: The probe-bound proteins were captured with neutravidin-coated beads and analyzed via LC-MS/MS and bioinformatic tools.
incubated with 50 µl of ultra-high capacity neutravidin beads (100 µl of slurry, Pierce) for 60 minutes at 4 ° C with gentle shaking.
Beads were successively washed with 1 mL of PBS containing pi and 2% SDS and the supernatant was removed via centrifugation (2 min, 10000 rpm, 4X).
40 ³L of 1× laemli sample buffer was added to the beads and then beads were heated at 95 ° C for 10 minutes to elute the neutravidin bound proteins.
